meta.description:
[#037300[]]Eventide is an ambitious mod focused on creating a new campaign with its own unique lore. It takes place on a planet that once teemed with abundant, long-standing life but became a desolate wasteland following a massive catastrophe (though not one devoid of life). The planet is rich in valuable minerals and inhabited by numerous, extremely territorial life-forms.

[#FF0000[]]Note: The mod is still in early development; many things may change in the future, such as sprites, sounds, enemies, lore, etc.

Arachnophobia warning for sensitive individuals.

If you would like to contribute to the mod in any way, join our Discord server.
